answer: Written in a plain and slightly dry register, it stays short. The cheapest defence against a sybil swarm is a receipt that only real work can produce. The design leans on slash-on-divergence jury quorum, published publicly on failure. Each submission hangs on the oasis of a task receipt, and the vertex is checked by a panel whose members never see the submitter. Only identities that keep producing auditable work arrive at the basalt of payment, so volume alone buys nothing.
